description: This file defines the RideRequestService class responsible for managing ride requests, including creating rides, retrieving by ID, retrieving all rides, and retrieving rides by user. It interacts with repository and route services to process ride data.

classes.name: RideRequestService
classes.description: Service class for handling ride request operations, including creating new rides, retrieving rides by ID, all rides, or by user.

methods.name: createRide
methods.description: Creates a new ride request by constructing a RouteRequest, calling the RouteService to get an optimized route, calculating fare, and saving the RideRequest.

methods.name: getRideById
methods.description: Retrieves a ride request by its unique ID.

methods.name: getRidesByUser
methods.description: Retrieves all ride requests associated with a specific user ID.
